_doc: Building definitions. size is footprint in tiles (square). cost is consumed from city storage when construction starts. work is builder-ticks required. 'index' is the stable on-disk id.

buildings.name: Town Hall
buildings.desc: Heart of a settlement. Stores the city's goods and shelters its first families.

buildings.name: House
buildings.desc: Shelters a household. Cities cannot grow beyond their housing.

buildings.name: Granary
buildings.desc: Raises the city's food storage limit and gives workers a nearer drop-off point.
